For long-term storage, 40–60% is kindest to lithium-ion; very low limits only reduce how long you can run unplugged.

data.name: Keyboard_MysticHint

data.value: The keyboard controller's own auto-off doesn't reach these keys, so Wattkin does it: the light goes off when the laptop's keyboard hasn't been used for the time above, and comes back on with its next key press. Another keyboard doesn't wake it. Wattkin only notices that a key was pressed, never which one. While Windows is locked the light stays on, so you can see the keys for your password.

data.value: Auto-off is built into the keyboard controller: the light goes off after about 10 seconds without typing and comes back on with a key press. The controller turns auto-off back on every boot, so Wattkin re-applies your choice at startup and after sleep.
